我们看到一艘受损舰船的模糊轮廓漂浮在虚空中。

倾斜的压迫感移入我们的心智中，而舰船也开始发生变化。裂缝密封，腐蚀消退，金属恢复平整。慢慢地，毁灭的痕迹被逆转了。

舰船被修复完成后，这个幻视戛然而止。只给我们留下了由内而外更新了的感觉。

texts.en:
A vertiginous apex looms over our thoughts; it is the Pale Mountain itself. Our minds strain as a vision overwhelms all senses.

We see the hazy outline of a damaged vessel before us, adrift in the void.

Somewhere in our minds the oblique pressure shifts, and the vessel begins to transform. Fissures seal, corrosion fades, and metal straightens. Slowly the legacy of its destruction is unmade.

Once the ship is fully repaired, the vision ends abruptly. We are left only with a profound sensation of renewal within.

label.zh: 我们思想的一次伟大重生。
label.en: A grand rebirth of our minds.

# 重塑 / Reformed

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:8008-8040`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5819-5854 (on_patron_delve_failed: 28 events × 100, utopia.3002 × 1)`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:8,109-114 (attunement ±50/100/200; 30-year retrigger 10800 days)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

潜入虚境但没有找到其他事件（on_patron_delve_failed）时，从28个权重各为100的遭遇（另有权重1的 utopia.3002 兜底）中随机抽取一个满足条件的；每次潜入失败只出现一个遭遇，不会依次经历全部。要求与小赞助者“苍茫之层峦”已完成接触、未在“自寻出路”、处于喰煞或织缕领域之一，每个帝国一次。

When a Shroud delve finds nothing else (on_patron_delve_failed), one eligible encounter is drawn at random from 28 candidates of weight 100 each (plus utopia.3002 at weight 1 as fallback); each failed delve shows one encounter, never all of them in sequence. Requires completed contact with the minor patron the Pale Mountain, not forging its own path, and being in the domain of the Eater or the Composer; once per empire.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

苍茫之层峦让我们看到一艘受损舰船被修复。

The Pale Mountain shows a damaged vessel being restored.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项：解锁法令“重生之意”。

Only option: unlocks the edict Will of Rebirth.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照原文核实了触发、选项与回复事件；草稿结构正确（选项→各自的回复窗口，互斥）。本遭遇与同池其他遭遇相互独立，不应串成一条故事。

Trigger, options and reply events were checked against the source; the draft structure is right (each option → its own reply window, mutually exclusive). This encounter is independent of the others in the pool and must not be chained with them.
